route_for_V1.idea: componentwise through a linear isometry e : W ~ EuclideanSpace R (Fin m); each coordinate is scalar K-Lipschitz (V4') and gets its own L7 partition; V3 takes a countable common refinement (N^m countable, complement inside m null sets); V4'' gives differentiability of u from the coordinates; V4 upgrades coordinatewise first-order agreement to vector first-order agreement with e.symm of the C^1 scalar representatives
route_for_V1.risk: V3 bookkeeping (measurability/disjointness of the refinement) and V4 (componentwise fderiv through e) are the two places this could turn out heavier than expected; if so V1 falls back to a vector-target Whitney extension
